scope: DPP Autopilot only. Unrelated tables in the shared Supabase project are explicitly out of scope.
data_subjects: DPP organization users represented by Supabase Auth user IDs and organization memberships
Prospective client and manufacturer contacts submitting DPP onboarding or early-access data

processors_and_recipients.name: Supabase
processors_and_recipients.data: identity/auth, DPP database records, onboarding/application records, evidence metadata and private dpp-evidence object bytes
processors_and_recipients.status: Auth/Postgres active; private dpp-evidence Storage and caller-JWT evidence Edge Function deployed; final lifecycle acceptance remains incomplete

processors_and_recipients.name: Vercel
processors_and_recipients.data: HTTP request metadata and DPP API payloads when deployed
processors_and_recipients.status: preview/production deployment evidence exists; final production acceptance remains dependent on remaining gates

processors_and_recipients.name: GitHub
processors_and_recipients.data: source code and synthetic test fixtures only; production personal data is prohibited by project policy

processors_and_recipients.name: EU DPP registry provider
processors_and_recipients.data: approved DPP registry request payload and technical submission metadata

stores.purpose: Account authentication, recovery, security and identity linkage
stores.fields: email/phone when configured, password hash, confirmation/recovery/security metadata, timestamps and provider metadata

retention.current_behavior: Managed by Supabase Auth account lifecycle; DPP deletion/retention policy not yet accepted

controls: R06 recovery redirect and fragment consumption

stores.purpose: Tenant membership, roles and active organization authorization

retention.current_behavior: Rows persist until membership/user/organization lifecycle deletion or cascade; no time-based expiry

stores.purpose: Identify tenant organizations and route tenant-scoped records

retention.current_behavior: Persists until organization deletion; dependent DPP records use foreign-key lifecycle rules

stores.purpose: Collect authenticated prospective-client details needed to assess a DPP pilot, prepare a quote and bind an accepted application to an organization
stores.fields: auth user ID, email, company/contact name, country, website, employee/user/site counts, systems, product categories, SKU and annual-unit estimates, notes, quote values, status, organization linkage and timestamps

retention.current_behavior: Applications persist while pilot/commercial review is active and currently have no accepted time-based expiry; user deletion cascades the application.

controls: application ownership derived from authenticated user context

stores.purpose: Support registration requests and time-bounded early-access dashboard links before or during client onboarding
stores.fields: email, registration/application/user linkage, registration status and timestamps; token hash, company/manufacturer/country/request text, session status, open/submission/expiry timestamps

retention.current_behavior: Registration requests currently have no accepted time-based purge. Early-access sessions carry a server-side expires_at default of 30 days, but automated deletion after expiry is not yet accepted or evidenced.

controls: registration verification binds authenticated user email
early-access link secrets are represented by token hashes
bounded email and business text fields

stores.purpose: Persist the eight manufacturer onboarding answers and derive tenant-scoped company/workflow defaults without fabricating product technical data
stores.fields: organization/user IDs, question key, raw and structured answer values, company/manufacturer defaults, battery preferences, serial/batch workflow, production scale, import and QR-print methods, revision and timestamps

retention.current_behavior: Answers and configuration persist with the tenant lifecycle; organization deletion cascades both stores and no separate time-based expiry is implemented.

controls: structured values must be JSON objects
configuration derivation excludes fabricated product technical characteristics

stores.purpose: Maintain canonical battery model/item records required for DPP workflows
stores.fields: model/manufacturer/category, battery unique identifier, lifecycle status, canonical_data JSON, production batch key/request fingerprint/quantity, batch membership, creator user ID and timestamps

retention.current_behavior: Battery/model records and committed provisioning batch metadata persist until authorized lifecycle/deletion; no automatic time-based expiry.

controls: batch provisioning direct client access denied

stores.purpose: Create versioned DPP passport projections with explicit public/private split
stores.fields: public_payload, private_payload, status, battery linkage, creator/change actor IDs, version timestamps

retention.current_behavior: Current passport plus version history persists; version history is append-oriented and has no accepted time-based retention

stores.purpose: Hold LMT authority-only evidence needed for passport readiness without exposing its payload through organization/public APIs
stores.location: Supabase Postgres public DPP namespace with deny-by-default direct client access
stores.fields: organization_id, model_id, regulatory field number, authority-only evidence JSON, creator user ID, timestamps

retention.current_behavior: Persists with the tenant/model lifecycle; final authority access and retention policy are pending.

stores.purpose: Map, validate and transactionally commit imported DPP product data
stores.fields: source headers/mapping, normalized model/item JSON, validation errors, creator ID, processing timestamps

retention.current_behavior: Terminal invalid/committed import runs may be purged only after 30 days through owner/admin dpp_api_purge_import_staging(); staged/validated runs are preserved; final accepted policy remains pending.

controls: R08 owner/admin terminal staging purge with immutable audit DELETE evidence

stores.purpose: Track DPP registry request/response state, retries, external references and idempotency
stores.location: Supabase Postgres public DPP namespace; approved payload may later be transmitted to external registry provider
stores.fields: request/response payloads, external reference, provider/environment/status, errors/retries, creator ID and timestamps

retention.current_behavior: Submission history persists; obvious credential-bearing JSON keys are technically blocked from request/response payload storage.

controls: credential-key guard helper and trigger function not client-executable
stores.minimization_note: Registry request/response JSON must not persist obvious credential-bearing keys. Provider/legal payload scope and retention terms still require acceptance before live delivery.

stores.purpose: Attach evidence to DPP records with integrity metadata
stores.location: Metadata in Supabase Postgres; private object bytes in Supabase Storage bucket dpp-evidence via caller-JWT Edge Function dpp-evidence-object
stores.fields: storage path, original filename, content type, size, SHA-256, metadata JSON, creator ID, timestamps and object bytes

retention.current_behavior: Metadata and private object bytes persist; deployed upload path verifies byte_size/SHA-256/content_type before Storage write. Final retention period remains pending.

controls: private dpp-evidence Storage bucket with tenant RLS

stores.purpose: Maintain immutable accountability trail for DPP record changes
stores.fields: actor_id, organization_id, action, target identifiers, before/after JSON snapshots and timestamp

retention.current_behavior: Audit rows remain append-only/immutable. Credential-bearing JSON keys are recursively redacted in audit copies before insertion; accepted retention period remains pending.

controls: recursive audit-only credential-key redaction before immutable insert
source rows are not modified by audit redaction
redaction helper has no anon/authenticated EXECUTE

stores.purpose: Bind DPP app/repository namespace and prevent cross-project confusion
stores.fields: app key, repository name, binding mode, notes and timestamp

retention.current_behavior: Retained while the DPP application binding exists

stores.purpose: Abuse prevention before upstream API work with shared authenticated budgets
stores.location: Process-local serverless memory plus Supabase Postgres DPP namespace for authenticated shared buckets
stores.processor: Application runtime/Vercel when deployed; Supabase for shared authenticated counters
stores.fields: truncated SHA-256 digest values derived from network and Authorization identities, surface/rule namespace, counters and timestamps; raw IP addresses and bearer credentials are not stored

retention.current_behavior: Process-local entries are pruned/capped; shared authenticated rows are opportunistically deleted after their reset time is older than 10 minutes.

controls: raw IP and bearer token are never stored in bucket keys
direct anon/authenticated table privileges revoked with RLS enabled
shared consume RPC requires authenticated user context

stores.purpose: Bind QR/NFC carriers to battery items and record carrier scan events for operational/audit evidence
stores.fields: organization_id, battery_item_id, carrier kind/technology, public URL, optional external UID, status, actor IDs and timestamps; scan source/result and optional actor_id

retention.current_behavior: Carrier bindings and scan history persist with the tenant/battery lifecycle; no accepted time-based expiry is implemented.

stores.purpose: Persist terminal passport lifecycle disposition and replacement linkage for persistent public QR/NFC resolution
stores.fields: passport_id, organization_id, disposition, reason code/note, replacement_item_id, changed_by auth user ID and changed_at

retention.current_behavior: Lifecycle metadata persists with passport history; no accepted time-based expiry is implemented.

controls: RLS enabled with no direct anon/authenticated table privileges

out_of_scope_shared_project_data: All non-dpp_* application tables in the shared Supabase project are owned by other applications and are not part of DPP Autopilot privacy inventory.
green_blockers: M01-M13 declared dependencies are not all GREEN.
Final regulatory/operational retention periods remain unaccepted for passports/history, registry submissions, evidence and audit snapshots.
M13 real authenticated deployed evidence lifecycle acceptance remains incomplete.
External registry recipient terms and live payload scope are not accepted.
R08 destructive organization/user deletion remains intentionally disabled pending accepted export/storage/audit/Auth lifecycle rules.

deletion_export_precursor.impact_preview: owner/admin only; non-destructive; reports tenant row/object/auth-context impact and blocker codes
deletion_export_precursor.export_evidence_bytes: bounded opt-in integrity-checked base64 precursor; exhaustive package/streaming acceptance pending
